pathContract.rejects: absolute, drive, UNC, backslash, NUL, empty/dot/traversal segment, non-NFC, Windows-invalid or reserved segment, duplicate, case-fold collision, symlink, submodule, directory

contentContract.classification: explicit text for this closed .ts/.sql dependency set
contentContract.text: strict UTF-8; preserve BOM, code points, whitespace, and final-newline presence; normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF only
contentContract.binary: exact Git blob bytes with no transformation

treeHashContract: SHA-256 over ASCII 'C3_HEARTH_DEPENDENCY_TREE_V1\0', u32be file count, then unsigned-UTF8-path-sorted entries framed as mode6ASCII, one kind byte (0x01 for text; 0x02 for binary), u32be path length, path UTF-8, u64be canonical content length, and 32-byte canonical content SHA-256

portabilityProof.independentFreshCheckoutCounterVerificat: Required in LF and CRLF checkouts at the same sourceCommit; checkout locations must not enter the artifact.
